description: This file defines the SugarWidgetSubPanelTopSummaryButton class, which extends SugarWidgetSubPanelTopButton, and provides a method to generate HTML for a button that opens a popup with summarized activity history related to a specific module in the SuiteCRM application.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelTopSummaryButton
classes.description: A widget class used to generate a top summary button in subpanels, specifically for showing accumulated history related to activities, with access control.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates HTML code for a button that opens a popup showing accumulated history for activities related to the current module, considering access permissions.
